mapper.delete: DELETE FROM edudoc_document_chunk WHERE document_version_id = HEXTORAW(#{versionIdHex})
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM edudoc_document_chunk WHERE document_version_id = HEXTORAW(#{versionIdHex})

SELECT RAWTOHEX(c.id) AS id, RAWTOHEX(c.document_version_id) AS documentVersionId, c.chunk_no AS chunkNo, c.heading_path AS headingPath, c.page_no AS pageNo, c.char_start AS charStart, c.char_end AS charEnd, c.content_text AS contentText, c.token_count AS tokenCount, c.content_hash AS contentHash, c.index_status AS indexStatus FROM edudoc_document_chunk c WHERE c.document_version_id = HEXTORAW(#{versionIdHex}) ORDER BY c.chunk_no
